feature: Project-scoped immediate experience reuse pause and resume

behavior.entry: 任务复盘顶部 → 立即暂停经验复用 / 恢复经验复用
behavior.activation: Available while a task is running or advice draft is being edited. Stops future turn experience selection; already submitted model context cannot be retracted. An in-flight source lookup rechecks the switch before returning advice.
behavior.persistence: Revision-guarded project journal event and portable artifact, separate from draft library and released strategies. Survives restart and project copying; other projects remain independent.
behavior.preservation: Drafts, releases, regression cases and historical validation reports remain intact. Publishing or rolling back a release never resumes reuse.
behavior.context: An empty selection resets the provider session when prior experience context differs, so a new turn does not inherit paused advice.
behavior.failure: Malformed/unknown-version/foreign/secret-bearing inputs rejected. A corrupt newest switch record stops reuse. Cancelled and disposed writes cannot append a late switch; disposed UI drops late results.

focused.note: An existing 5 ms timer fixture intermittently completed below its asserted duration; increased its delay to 20 ms and reran all 45 focused logic cases successfully.

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and configured-value scan of generated files; no real credential store is read. A zero crash-dump count means no dump was generated.
